_comment: Curated editorial records for canonical connectors whose core row arrived without website copy. Facts only: each is checkable against the provider's public documentation; scopes/tools are corroborated by core where noted. Applied by scripts/sync-catalogue.py.

whEvents: Mailbox change notification (Google Cloud Pub/Sub push)
uc: Draft replies for a person to review and send
Find the messages an agent task needs
reqs: A Gmail or Google Workspace account
A Google Cloud OAuth client (client ID and secret)
The Gmail API enabled in that Google Cloud project
gmail.flow: OAuth 2.0 authorization code with refresh tokens. Tokens are held in the credential vault; the agent never sees them.
gmail.d: Gmail is Google's email service. The connector lists and reads messages and creates drafts through the Gmail API — it drafts; a person sends.
gmail.l: The Gmail connector (Golden Five set, Manifest 1.3) reads messages and drafts and creates drafts through the Gmail API under the account owner's OAuth grant. Every write is policy-checked and approval-gated. Gmail push notifications arrive through Google Cloud Pub/Sub; they are treated as untrusted triggers and confirmed by reading back from the API.
gmail.description_source: editorial record 2026-10-03 from the Gmail API public documentation (developers.google.com/gmail/api); auth, scopes, tools and the Pub/Sub webhook profile corroborated by core's Gmail Manifest 1.3 simulator manifest (packages/runtime/simulators/manifests/gmail.v13.json @ f6a3161) — the Golden Five pack manifest itself was not in the supplied packs
